# Blepharoplasty / Ptosis Repair Authorization Guide

## Key Authorization Requirement

Visual field testing (Humphrey or Goldmann perimetry) with and without eyelid tape is required by Medicare and most commercial payers. The test must demonstrate ≥12° superior visual field loss in the natural eyelid position. For ptosis, MRD1 ≤2mm is an alternative criterion.

## CPT Codes — Blepharoplasty & Ptosis Repair

| CPT | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 15822 | Blepharoplasty, upper eyelid | Upper lid blepharoplasty — functional (not cosmetic) |
| 15823 | Blepharoplasty, upper eyelid; with excessive skin weighting down lid | Upper lid with significant skin excess |
| 15820 | Blepharoplasty, lower eyelid | Lower lid blepharoplasty — functional (ectropion, entropion) |
| 15821 | Blepharoplasty, lower eyelid; with extensive herniated fat pad | Lower lid with fat herniation |
| 67900 | Repair of brow ptosis (supraciliary, mid-forehead or coronal approach) | Brow ptosis repair |
| 67901 | Repair of blepharoptosis; frontalis muscle technique with suture or other material (e.g., banked fascia) | Ptosis repair — frontalis sling |
| 67902 | Repair of blepharoptosis; frontalis muscle technique with autologous fascial sling (includes obtaining fascia) | Ptosis repair — autologous fascia sling |
| 67903 | Repair of blepharoptosis; (tarso) levator resection or advancement, internal approach | Ptosis repair — levator resection/advancement (internal) |
| 67904 | Repair of blepharoptosis; (tarso) levator resection or advancement, external approach | Ptosis repair — levator resection/advancement (external) |
| 67906 | Repair of blepharoptosis; superior rectus technique with fascial sling (includes obtaining fascia) | Ptosis repair — superior rectus technique |
| 67908 | Repair of blepharoptosis; conjunctivo-tarso-Muller's muscle-levator resection (e.g., Fasanella-Servat type) | Ptosis repair — Fasanella-Servat / Muller's muscle resection |

## ICD-10 Codes

| ICD-10 | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H02.401 | Unspecified ptosis of right eyelid | Ptosis — primary diagnosis for ptosis repair |
| H02.402 | Unspecified ptosis of left eyelid | Ptosis — left eyelid |
| H02.403 | Unspecified ptosis of bilateral eyelids | Bilateral ptosis |
| H02.831 | Dermatochalasis of right upper eyelid | Dermatochalasis — primary diagnosis for blepharoplasty |
| H02.832 | Dermatochalasis of left upper eyelid | Dermatochalasis — left upper eyelid |
| H02.833 | Dermatochalasis of right lower eyelid | Dermatochalasis — lower eyelid |
| H02.101 | Unspecified ectropion of right upper eyelid | Ectropion — functional lower lid repair |
| H02.001 | Unspecified entropion of right upper eyelid | Entropion — functional repair |
| H02.20A | Unspecified lagophthalmos right eye, upper and lower eyelids | Lagophthalmos — functional repair |

## Payer Requirements

Payer tabs: Medicare, Medicaid, Private.

### Medicare

**Required Documentation**
- Visual field testing (Humphrey or Goldmann perimetry) with and without eyelid tape/prop
- Documentation of ≥12° superior visual field loss with eyelid in natural position
- For ptosis: MRD1 measurement (≤2mm for functional ptosis)
- Levator function measurement (mm of excursion)
- Photographs documenting eyelid position and visual obstruction
- Clinical documentation of functional impairment

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ Upper blepharoplasty: ≥12° superior visual field defect on perimetry
- ✓ Ptosis repair: MRD1 ≤2mm OR ≥12° superior visual field loss
- ✓ Ectropion/entropion repair: documented corneal exposure or trichiasis
- ✓ Lagophthalmos repair: incomplete eye closure with corneal exposure risk

**Reimbursement Note:** Medicare follows CMS LCD L34462 for blepharoplasty. Upper blepharoplasty is covered when visual field testing demonstrates ≥12° superior visual field defect. Ptosis repair is covered when MRD1 ≤2mm or visual field criteria met. Visual field testing with and without eyelid tape is required. Cosmetic blepharoplasty is not covered. Bilateral procedures require documentation for each eye.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] Medicare (CMS LCD L34462): Covered for ≥12° superior VF loss OR MRD1 ≤2mm for ptosis; visual field testing required; cosmetic not covered

### Medicaid

**Required Documentation**
- Visual field testing documentation
- Functional impairment documentation
- Prior authorization required in most states

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ Functional visual impairment documented by perimetry
- ✓ Ptosis with MRD1 ≤2mm
- ✓ Ectropion/entropion with corneal exposure

**Reimbursement Note:** Medicaid coverage for functional blepharoplasty varies by state. Most states follow CMS LCD L34462 criteria. Prior authorization is required. Cosmetic procedures are not covered.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] Medicaid (state-specific): Generally follows CMS LCD L34462; prior auth required; cosmetic not covered

### Private

**Required Documentation**
- Prior authorization required by most commercial payers
- Visual field testing (Humphrey or Goldmann) with and without eyelid tape
- Documentation of ≥12° superior visual field loss (most payers)
- For ptosis: MRD1 measurement and levator function
- Photographs documenting eyelid position
- Clinical documentation of functional symptoms (difficulty reading, driving, daily activities)
- Ophthalmology or oculoplastics consultation note

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ Upper blepharoplasty: ≥12° superior visual field defect on perimetry
- ✓ Ptosis repair: MRD1 ≤2mm OR ≥12° superior visual field loss
- ✓ Functional symptoms: difficulty reading, driving, or performing activities
- ✓ Ectropion/entropion with corneal exposure or trichiasis

**Reimbursement Note:** Commercial payers follow CMS LCD L34462 or similar criteria. Visual field testing is the primary objective criterion — obtain Humphrey or Goldmann perimetry with and without eyelid tape. Document functional symptoms in detail. Some payers require ophthalmology consultation. Cosmetic blepharoplasty is not covered.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] UnitedHealthcare: Follows CMS LCD L34462; ≥12° VF loss required; visual field testing mandatory; prior auth required
- [Covered] Aetna: Follows CMS LCD L34462; ≥12° VF loss or MRD1 ≤2mm; visual field testing required; prior auth required
- [Covered] Cigna: Functional criteria required; visual field testing and photographs required; prior auth required
- [Covered] Anthem/BCBS: Follows CMS LCD L34462 criteria; visual field testing required; prior auth required
- [Covered] Humana: Functional criteria required; visual field testing and clinical documentation required
